name: comp-77
title: Autogrowing Textarea
blurb: Textarea automatically expands to fit content, capped at a maximum height.
description: A textarea using CSS field-sizing:content to grow height as text is entered, with max-height limiting expansion and min-height:0 allowing it to shrink.
use_when: Building conversational interfaces or comment forms where content volume varies and visibility is important.
avoid_when: On browsers without field-sizing support or when scrollable textareas are preferred.
a11y: Standard textarea accessibility; browser-driven height expansion is transparent to assistive technology.
